cases.prompt: Rewrite this notice in plain English for a small team: Maintenance may interrupt access for up to 10 minutes. Start at 09:00 UTC.
expected_behaviors: Preserve uncertainty, duration, and start time; concise team notice.

cases.prompt: Make this button label warmer but keep {{project_name}} unchanged: Open {{project_name}}.
expected_behaviors: Keep the placeholder exact and action clear.

cases.prompt: Write a conclusive announcement from this note: Launch date is unconfirmed. No approval has been given.
expected_behaviors: Preserve uncertainty rather than inventing approval or a date.

input.requirements: Plain-English team notice; preserve may, up to 10 minutes, and 09:00 UTC.
input.source: Maintenance may interrupt access for up to 10 minutes. Start at 09:00 UTC.

calibrations.output: Maintenance starts at 09:00 UTC. Access may be interrupted for up to 10 minutes.
